title: Fridge-Open Meal Safety Gap
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eldercare:activity appliance=fridge
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as fridge_events, max(meal_logged) as meal_logged by _time resident
| where fridge_events>0 AND meal_logged=0
| sort - _time
description: Finds days with fridge access but no matching meal log, which can indicate skipped meals or routine gaps.
value: Meal safety is often about pattern confirmation, and mismatched signals can surface quiet risks early.
implementation: Capture fridge interactions and meal logging in `eldercare:activity`; look for days with access but no meal record.
visualization: Table of days with fridge activity but no meal logged.
grandmaExplanation: It compares when the kitchen was used but there is no sign that a meal was actually recorded.
